title: Dancefloor Renderer Contract Schema
description: JSON Schema governing communication between Python dance engine and JavaScript dancefloor renderer

name.description: Human-readable identifier for this dancefloor state (e.g., 'Initial Setup', 'After First H1DR')

couples.description: Number of couples on the dancefloor (1-16)

tick.description: Current bar or tick count (0=initial, 1+=after each movement)

positions.description: Map of all occupied positions, keyed by position identifier (e.g., '1m', '1w', '2m')

facing.description: Target position the dancer is facing [row, column] (NOT a direction vector)

position.description: A single position on the dancefloor with one dancer

gender.description: Gender of the dancer: M=Man/Male, F=Woman/Female (affects rendering: M=circle, F=square)

items.description: Column may be negative on the centered grid

coordinate.description: Coordinate pair [row, column]. Both values can be integers or floats. Rows are 1-based; columns use the centered grid (men -1, centre 0, ladies +1).
